hero.title: Public services that *reach further*.
hero.line: Built with the Government of Karnataka. Newron meets citizens in their own language and runs entirely inside government infrastructure — so digital services don't leave people behind.

sections.title: From the grievance desk to the *archive*.
sections.line: Language, voice and document understanding, assembled into services citizens can actually use.

cards.d: Citizens speak in their own dialect; Newron classifies, routes, retrieves the policy and drafts a response for officer approval.
Custom OCR reads Kannada handwriting and print from ledgers and forms that were never digitised.
Surface the exact rule from circulars and PDFs, with a citation, so frontline staff answer correctly the first time.

sections.title: Service at the speed of a *phone call*.
sections.line: Across grievance categories in the Karnataka deployment.

steps.d: Deploy on-premise or air-gapped within state data centres, with explicit data-residency commitments.
Newron drafts and routes; an officer reviews and approves every response, with a full audit log.
Voice-first intake in Kannada, so a citizen who cannot fill an English form can still be heard.
Every answer is sourced to the governing rule, and every case is logged for oversight.

faq.q: Can Newron run inside our data centre?
faq.a: Yes. Public-sector deployments run on-premise or air-gapped within state infrastructure, with data-residency commitments.
Kannada is in production, including handwriting. Other Indian languages are extensions the stack is built for, but each needs its own data and evaluation before we would call it supported.
Data stays within government infrastructure, processing is logged end to end, and access is controlled and auditable.
No — it removes the mechanical work. Officers review and approve responses; Newron handles intake, routing, retrieval and drafting.

cta.title: Start with a single *grievance category*.
cta.line: We work with state bodies to scope a pilot on your own infrastructure, with the audit trail and sovereignty your mandate requires.
